mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pipeline_control (pipeline_name, phase, updated_at) VALUES (#{pipelineName}, 'IDLE', now()) ON CONFLICT (pipeline_name) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'IMPORTING', owner_node = #{nodeId}, lease_until = now() + (#{leaseSeconds} * interval '1 second'), updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND ( (phase = 'IDLE') OR (phase = 'IMPORTING' AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < now()) )

UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'EXPORTING', owner_node = null, lease_until = null, transaction_date = #{transactionDate}, updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND phase = 'IMPORTING' AND owner_node = #{nodeId}
UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'IDLE', owner_node = null, lease_until = null, updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND phase = 'IMPORTING' AND owner_node = #{nodeId}
mapper.select: SELECT transaction_date FROM pipeline_control WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND phase = 'EXPORTING' AND transaction_date IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE pipeline_control SET phase = 'IDLE', transaction_date = null, updated_at = now() WHERE pipeline_name = #{pipelineName} AND phase = 'EXPORTING' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM export_job WHERE checkpoint_date = #{transactionDate} AND status NOT IN ('done', 'failed'))
